trials.claim: Purchased Premium models never expire and can be edited and replaced at any time without limitations
trials.claimQuote: Purchased Premium models never expire and you can edit and replace them at any time w/o limitations
trials.reasoning: E1 only says some controls are a Premium feature; it does not show purchased Premium models expire or cannot be edited or replaced, and no exhibit confirms those promises.

exhibits.quote: especially when the controls are limited (Premium feature).
exhibits.argument: Quote shows editing and display controls are limited and gated behind Premium, contradicting the claim of editing and replacing without limitations.

trials.claim: Lifetime hosting, embedding and AR viewing is included for purchased 3D models
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime hosting and embedding and AR viewing of your purchased 3D models
trials.reasoning: Reviews confirm options for embedding models and sharing them online or in AR. E2's ownership concern does not contradict that hosting, embedding, and AR viewing are included.

exhibits.quote: I'm not too happy about the fact they own your models if you don't set them as a Private model.
exhibits.argument: Quote indicates vendor claims ownership of hosted models unless marked Private, undermining the promise of lifetime hosting and control for purchased models.

exhibits.quote: There are tons of options for sharing and embedding the models into your website.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms embedding of purchased models is included as claimed.

exhibits.quote: I love that I can share my 3D models online or in AR with just a few clicks.
exhibits.argument: Quote confirms AR viewing of purchased models is included as claimed.
